author: Aoki
notes: Credit, and a start and finish read from the map's own spawns and end teleport (gb-maps-1). Fifteen levels, each announced by a trigger_once (aoki_lv2..aoki_lv15) that fades in its sign; they are not stage lines here yet, because a sign trigger is where a level's name appears, not necessarily a line every route crosses. The finish: gotoendddddddd, the one teleport into the end room (enddddddddddd), whose floor trigger sets off the map's ending and sends the player back to the start. Its 95 teleports behind filter_activator are anti-standing blocks (sinking blocks here, not pits), and the 14 start-disabled aoki_lv* teleports are the hub's level-select pads, dropped. Not published.
